title: Protect superseding search content during embedding publication
raw_body: Before persisting an embedding result, indexing SHALL reload the search document and compare its source fingerprint to the indexed content. A different fingerprint SHALL prevent the older embedding from being published.
raw_block:
### Requirement: Protect superseding search content during embedding publication

Before persisting an embedding result, indexing SHALL reload the search document and compare its source fingerprint to the indexed content. A different fingerprint SHALL prevent the older embedding from being published.

#### Scenario: Newer content arrives during provider work
- **WHEN** the reloaded document has a different source fingerprint
- **THEN** the old embedding result is not saved over that document

scenarios.raw_block:

- **WHEN** the reloaded document has a different source fingerprint
- **THEN** the old embedding result is not saved over that document

title: Retain lexical content when embedding work fails
raw_body: An embedding exception or empty vector SHALL enter the indexing failure path. When the stored fingerprint still matches and failure persistence succeeds, embedding status SHALL become failed while lexical content remains ready. The exception SHALL propagate to shared workflow handling; successful retry is not guaranteed.
raw_block:
### Requirement: Retain lexical content when embedding work fails

An embedding exception or empty vector SHALL enter the indexing failure path. When the stored fingerprint still matches and failure persistence succeeds, embedding status SHALL become failed while lexical content remains ready. The exception SHALL propagate to shared workflow handling; successful retry is not guaranteed.

#### Scenario: Provider exception
- **WHEN** embedding generation throws after lexical publication
- **THEN** matching content remains lexical-ready, embedding status is marked failed and the exception propagates

#### Scenario: Empty provider result
- **WHEN** the provider returns an empty vector for nonempty content
- **THEN** indexing rejects that result through the failure path without publishing an empty embedding

title: Repair derived search state in bounded batches
raw_body: Search reconciliation SHALL scan ready non-deleted recipes in increasing ID order after an optional cursor, at most 50 per invocation. It SHALL attempt current-fingerprint index dispatch for missing/stale/pending/failed derived state when no equivalent Pending or Processing index workflow is found, and request continuation when a batch contains 50 recipes.
raw_block:
### Requirement: Repair derived search state in bounded batches

Search reconciliation SHALL scan ready non-deleted recipes in increasing ID order after an optional cursor, at most 50 per invocation. It SHALL attempt current-fingerprint index dispatch for missing/stale/pending/failed derived state when no equivalent Pending or Processing index workflow is found, and request continuation when a batch contains 50 recipes.

#### Scenario: Missing search state
- **WHEN** a ready active recipe has no search document and no equivalent active workflow
- **THEN** reconciliation creates pending state and requests current-fingerprint indexing

#### Scenario: Equivalent work active
- **WHEN** a Pending or Processing index workflow already represents the same recipe and fingerprint
- **THEN** reconciliation does not request another equivalent job in that invocation

#### Scenario: Full batch
- **WHEN** the scan returns 50 recipes
- **THEN** reconciliation requests another batch after the last scanned ID

title: Offer Home voting and library handoffs
raw_body: Home SHALL offer the active open household voting round regardless of target or Planner week. Collecting SHALL offer "Vote Now" to Discovery; converged SHALL show "Menu's In", "Your matches are ready to review and save." and "See your matches" to that round's meal plan, exactly in English with equivalent French intent. The invitation SHALL remain without dismissal while open. Copy SHALL NOT assume next week or claim recipe counts from days. Capture and Browse Library SHALL remain available.
raw_block:
### Requirement: Offer Home voting and library handoffs

Home SHALL offer the active open household voting round regardless of target or Planner week. Collecting SHALL offer "Vote Now" to Discovery; converged SHALL show "Menu's In", "Your matches are ready to review and save." and "See your matches" to that round's meal plan, exactly in English with equivalent French intent. The invitation SHALL remain without dismissal while open. Copy SHALL NOT assume next week or claim recipe counts from days. Capture and Browse Library SHALL remain available.

#### Scenario: This week open while next week is closed
- **WHEN** Home receives a confirmed collecting round for this week and next week is not open
- **THEN** Home offers Vote Now leading to Discovery for the active round without requiring a reload

#### Scenario: Next week open for voting
- **WHEN** the confirmed collecting round targets next week
- **THEN** Home offers Vote Now without requiring recipe-bearing scheduled days or claiming their count represents voting candidates

#### Scenario: Later week differs from Planner selection
- **WHEN** the confirmed open round targets a later week while Planner has another week selected
- **THEN** Home presents that active round's collecting or converged action independently of Planner selection

#### Scenario: Open round converges
- **WHEN** a collecting round becomes confirmed converged while Home is mounted
- **THEN** Home replaces Vote Now with the exact English headline "Menu's In", supporting copy "Your matches are ready to review and save." and button "See your matches"
- **AND** voting remains open until an explicit existing close action

#### Scenario: French matched-state copy
- **WHEN** Home presents the converged invitation in French
- **THEN** its localized headline, supporting sentence and action convey that matches are ready to review and save, without claiming saved meals or closed voting
- **AND** this Home copy does not change Discovery copy

#### Scenario: Closed or unowned round
- **WHEN** confirmed household state has no active open round, including after closing voting
- **THEN** Home removes the voting invitation while retaining Capture a Recipe and Browse Library links

#### Scenario: Invitation cannot be dismissed
- **WHEN** an open round remains active through Home interaction, leaving Home or returning to Home
- **THEN** its invitation remains available without a dismiss control or suppression inherited from another round

#### Scenario: Read fails or nudge dismissed
- **WHEN** a voting-status read fails or a person seeks the former nudge dismissal while voting is open
- **THEN** failure follows Present trustworthy Home voting status and recovery, and the open-round invitation has no dismiss control
- **AND** neither circumstance changes the plan or closes voting

#### Scenario: Live open and reopen
- **WHEN** voting opens or a closed week is reopened as a new round while Home is mounted
- **THEN** Home presents the new round's authoritative phase without retaining the prior round's completion state

title: Present trustworthy Home voting status and recovery
raw_body: Home SHALL distinguish confirmed status from checking and failed reads. It SHALL retain usable last-confirmed navigation during background rechecks and after failure, showing checking or unavailable/last-confirmed feedback and Retry after failure. Without a valid accepted round identity and destination it SHALL withhold the action. Accepted newer state SHALL replace or remove the action; rejected updates SHALL NOT confirm new state.
raw_block:
### Requirement: Present trustworthy Home voting status and recovery

Home SHALL distinguish confirmed status from checking and failed reads. It SHALL retain usable last-confirmed navigation during background rechecks and after failure, showing checking or unavailable/last-confirmed feedback and Retry after failure. Without a valid accepted round identity and destination it SHALL withhold the action. Accepted newer state SHALL replace or remove the action; rejected updates SHALL NOT confirm new state.

#### Scenario: Initial hydration
- **WHEN** Home has no confirmed voting snapshot and the initial status read is pending
- **THEN** it shows a compact checking status without Vote Now, See your matches or a claim that voting is closed
- **AND** Tonight and other Home navigation remain usable

#### Scenario: Read fails or status is stale
- **WHEN** a background recheck is pending for a last-confirmed open round with usable identity and destination
- **THEN** Home keeps its read-only navigation action usable with checking feedback without claiming the round was newly confirmed
- **AND** activating the action leaves destination reconciliation to Discovery or Planner without a handoff mutation

#### Scenario: Failed read with a usable last-confirmed round
- **WHEN** a refresh fails while a usable last-confirmed open round is retained and no accepted newer state supersedes it
- **THEN** Home retains its navigation action with unavailable status identifying it as last confirmed, and offers Retry
- **AND** failure does not newly confirm that round, hide the invitation or mutate the plan

#### Scenario: Failed read without a usable destination
- **WHEN** initial status fails or no retained accepted round provides a valid identity and destination
- **THEN** Home shows unavailable status with Retry and withholds round navigation instead of guessing its week

#### Scenario: Unusable authoritative response
- **WHEN** the current authoritative read completes with a projection rejected by the existing session validation owner and no newer accepted update has superseded that read
- **THEN** its status becomes unavailable rather than remaining indefinitely loading, and Home offers Retry
- **AND** any retained usable last-confirmed navigation follows the failed-read policy without adopting the rejected projection

#### Scenario: Rejected live projection
- **WHEN** existing validation rejects a malformed live projection
- **THEN** it does not replace accepted round data or establish newly confirmed state
- **AND** Home follows the retained accepted state; this rejection alone does not promise an unavailable transition or Retry, and existing reconnect/resume reconciliation remains available

#### Scenario: Retry reconciles a closed round
- **WHEN** Retry succeeds after an unavailable open-round snapshot and confirms no open round
- **THEN** Home removes the invitation and unavailable feedback

#### Scenario: Reconnect or mobile resume
- **WHEN** the existing household live connection reconnects, or the app resumes through visible or pageshow events after a missed open, close or convergence update
- **THEN** Home follows the reconciled current round and phase without requiring reload

#### Scenario: Delayed or different-host update
- **WHEN** an older update arrives after a newer round state, or an update from an unconfirmed server incarnation arrives
- **THEN** Home does not regress to the older state or treat the different host's update as confirmed before authoritative reconciliation

### Requirement: Compute a completed-week interest signal

Recent interest SHALL use canonical week starts in the prior N complete planning weeks, default N=4, excluding the current calendar week and active reopened week. Positive unselected rows SHALL contribute at most once per recipe/week. Normalized H SHALL be qualifying week count divided by N, never a live vote total.

#### Scenario: Four-week boundary
- **WHEN** current deployment-calendar Monday is 2026-10-12 and N=4
- **THEN** September 14, 21, 28 and October 5 qualify; September 7 and October 12 do not

#### Scenario: Revote old week
- **WHEN** a September 7 row is updated on October 14
- **THEN** the update does not move it into the October 12 lookback

#### Scenario: Timezone boundary
- **WHEN** UTC Sunday/Monday differs from deployment-local date
- **THEN** the deployment planning-calendar Monday defines the window, not each browser timezone

#### Scenario: One versus five likes
- **WHEN** a qualifying row has one like or five
- **THEN** either contributes one week to H; its stored aggregate count is unchanged

#### Scenario: No historical data
- **WHEN** history is absent or historical ranking is disabled
- **THEN** existing surface ranking keys remain, apart from explicitly specified final stable ties and independently enabled cooldown

- **THEN** September 14, 21, 28 and October 5 qualify; September 7 and October 12 do not

- **WHEN** a September 7 row is updated on October 14
- **THEN** the update does not move it into the October 12 lookback

- **WHEN** UTC Sunday/Monday differs from deployment-local date
- **THEN** the deployment planning-calendar Monday defines the window, not each browser timezone

- **WHEN** a qualifying row has one like or five
- **THEN** either contributes one week to H; its stored aggregate count is unchanged

- **THEN** existing surface ranking keys remain, apart from explicitly specified final stable ties and independently enabled cooldown

title: Keep historical eligibility independent of Discovery visibility
raw_body: Historical signal calculation SHALL NOT suppress eligible positive interest solely because a recipe is outside Discovery or under cooldown. Surface-specific candidate rules SHALL decide eligibility separately. Selected-row history SHALL not itself contribute unselected interest.
raw_block:
### Requirement: Keep historical eligibility independent of Discovery visibility

Historical signal calculation SHALL NOT suppress eligible positive interest solely because a recipe is outside Discovery or under cooldown. Surface-specific candidate rules SHALL decide eligibility separately. Selected-row history SHALL not itself contribute unselected interest.

#### Scenario: Search cooled recipe
- **WHEN** a cooled recipe matches typed Search filters and has qualifying interest
- **THEN** its H is available to Search; cooldown does not remove the result or its signal

#### Scenario: Selected positive row
- **WHEN** a recipe has only a selected positive row in the lookback
- **THEN** that row contributes zero to H

title: Validate historical lookback configuration
raw_body: The API SHALL default historical lookback to four complete planning weeks. It SHALL validate an integer week count before activating configuration, reject nonpositive or malformed values with an actionable startup/configuration error, and keep this setting separate from Search rediscovery days. No user tuning control SHALL be added.
raw_block:
### Requirement: Validate historical lookback configuration

The API SHALL default historical lookback to four complete planning weeks. It SHALL validate an integer week count before activating configuration, reject nonpositive or malformed values with an actionable startup/configuration error, and keep this setting separate from Search rediscovery days. No user tuning control SHALL be added.

#### Scenario: Missing value
- **WHEN** the environment does not specify the setting
- **THEN** the API uses four weeks

#### Scenario: Invalid value
- **WHEN** the setting is zero, negative, fractional or not a number
- **THEN** the deployment reports invalid configuration rather than silently disabling safety or treating it as a month


#### Scenario: Reopen and close a prior week
- **WHEN** a qualifying historical week reopens then deliberately closes without touching recipe A
- **THEN** its H is excluded while active and can contribute again after close; A's untouched snapshot remains unchanged
